plan.goal: Critique the UX of Solstice Bank's account-opening flow (and adjacent pages) by exploring all key pages, interacting with visible controls, and validating mobile/desktop consistency.
plan.summary: Start on index.html to explore landing, then proceed to apply.html (the 8-step form) to interact with each step's controls (eligibility, personal info, etc.), check recovery paths (Cancel, Save & continue), and finally visit confirmation.html. Validate mobile viewports for critical elements and check for errors/warnings.
assumptions: apply.html will load successfully after initial timeout (retry if needed)
All pages follow the prescan's structure and control types
risk_hotspots: apply.html's 8-step form (especially ID upload, liveness, and risk questionnaire steps)
small tap targets on all pages (per layout warnings)

phases.title: Landing Page (index.html)
phases.objective: Validate landing page content, interactables, and mobile viewport
key_checks: Click 'Start application' and 'Open an account' links (verify they navigate to apply.html)
Check all top navigation links (Why Solstice, Pricing, etc.) for responsiveness
Validate mobile viewport: check tap targets (small ones flagged) and content layout
Verify console/network errors (prescan had timeouts, check if resolved)

phases.title: Application Form (apply.html)
phases.objective: Explore all 8 steps of the form, interact with controls, check recovery paths
key_checks: Step 1: Eligibility (check all checkboxes, click 'Continue')
Step 2: Personal info (interact with name/DOB/SSN fields, check 'Edit' flow)
Step 5: ID verification (mock upload, liveness modal interaction)
Step 6: Risk questionnaire (answer questions, check soft warning)
Step 7: Funding (select options, mock OAuth flow)
Step 8: Review (check 'Edit' for each section)
Recovery paths: Click 'Save & continue later' (check modal), Click 'Cancel application' (verify second confirmation)
Help drawer: Open/close on each step, check copy changes
Mobile viewport: Validate step navigation, tap targets, and form fields
exit_criteria: All visible form controls interacted with
Mobile viewport validated for critical steps

phases.title: Confirmation Page (confirmation.html)
phases.objective: Validate success page content and navigation
key_checks: Verify 'Back to home' link (navigates to index.html)
Check application number format (SOL-2026-XXXX-XX)
Validate mobile viewport: content layout and tap targets
Check console/network errors

phases.title: Cross-Check & Error Review
phases.objective: Validate all phases' findings, check for missed controls, and confirm error resolution
key_checks: Recheck small tap targets (per layout warnings) on all pages
Confirm no new console/network errors
Verify all critical controls (Continue, Cancel, Save) work as expected
Check mobile viewport consistency for all key pages

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 3 known HTML pages (index, apply, confirmation)
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible controls on apply.html (8 steps, checkboxes, buttons, uploads, modals) + key controls on index/confirmation
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (form steps, navigation, tap targets) on mobile viewport for index.html, apply.html (steps 1,5,8), and confirmation.html

notes: Retry apply.html load if initial timeout persists (prescan had a timeout, confirm page loads)
